content: Annual screening for neuropathy is recommended for young individuals with type 1 diabetes starting at puberty or at the age of 10 years, whichever occurs first. This screening should begin once the individual has had type 1 diabetes for a minimum duration of five years. The evaluation process should include a thorough assessment of symptoms related to neuropathy, a detailed inspection of the feet, and specific tests to evaluate vibration sensitivity and reflexes. These tests should be conducted using tools such as a monofilament or a tuning fork.
